//: Vercel reads this when Root Directory is set to apps/web.
The install command runs from the REPO ROOT (Vercel checks out the whole
repo), so workspace packages are installed and built before Next compiles —
without that step `@pricetrail/*` imports fail to resolve at build time.
buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @pricetrail/database generate && pnpm build:packages && cd apps/web && pnpm build
